observations: The Pareto front is h32_512, h64_512, h128_512, h512; single-layer h128 and h256 are absent.
h64_512 reaches mean Q.ANT accuracy 0.96713 with 88650 parameters versus h128 at 0.96283 with 101770 parameters.
h128_512 reaches 0.97263 with 171658 parameters versus h256 at 0.97000 with 203530 parameters.
h32_512 does not exceed h128 accuracy on full MNIST, unlike the corresponding Exp007 comparison.
Q.ANT CPU and PyTorch predictions differ on only 1-6 of 10000 test examples per run.
interpretation: Selected bottleneck-plus-expansion architectures retain a parameter-efficiency advantage on full MNIST, but the effect is not universal across every pair. The next falsification should test whether the fixed architectures generalize to a different dataset rather than continuing MNIST tuning.
limitations: MNIST remains a simple image dataset.
Q.ANT CPU backend results do not establish photonic latency, energy efficiency, throughput, or hardware behavior.
next_research_direction: Cross-dataset validation using the already-selected architectures without architecture search on the new dataset.
